settings.subheading: A plush 2-in-1 sofa cover and cat bed. Place it where your cat already hangs out — soft enough to nap on, beautiful enough to leave out when guests come over.

settings.heading: The more they lounge, the cozier their space.
settings.body: Cats love soft places to nap — but sofas collect fur, scratches, and mess. CozyClaw turns the spot they already love into a warm, fluffy lounging zone, while quietly protecting your furniture underneath. Designed with plush comfort and a supportive edge, it creates the perfect space for kneading, lounging, and deep naps.

settings.title: Supportive pillow design

settings.title: Sofa protection & non-slip base
settings.desc: Protects sofas from scratches, fur, spills, and daily wear, while the anti-slip backing keeps the cover securely in place.

settings.title: Durable & easy to clean
